gen-gf-goldman-gf-truculenta: Truculenta packs its tall lowercase into a compact, glowing line, every stroke held to a single thickness. Truculenta against Goldman's wide, parenthesis-round capitals is the sharpest thing here: tight and tubular beside loose and commanding.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-ubuntu: Ubuntu brings a lofty lowercase band that gives the text a modern, businesslike stance. And Goldman's wide, bold display letters sit above it, announcing each section before that tall body takes over.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-victor-mono: Goldman spreads out wide and bold, with round forms like open parentheses. It handles commanding headlines, while Victor Mono, a monospace with loose spacing and bowls left open on one side, does the precise, structured work of lining up text.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-viga: Goldman stretches its letters wide and gives them a big lowercase, all bold command. Viga follows in a sans where every stroke is cut to one width, so paragraphs run smooth, shadow-free and without hairlines.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-voces: Commanding in its wide, bold stance, Goldman leads, while Voces follows with tall lowercase and gentle stroke modulation underneath. One shouts clearly, the other murmurs.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-winky-rough: Bold, commanding Goldman spreads its round, parenthesis-like letters wide across the top, leaving Winky Rough a plain sans with lowercase nearly matching its capitals. Big on top, even-handed below.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-winky-sans: Wide-set letters with a big lowercase give Goldman its swagger, and its round forms read like open parentheses. Winky Sans then carries the text in a modern sans-serif whose capitals barely rise above the lowercase, so a long page reads smooth and level.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-yantramanav: Round forms like open parentheses, set wide and generous, are what make Goldman stand out. Yantramanav sits beneath as a huddled, tall-lowercase sans-serif, while Goldman earns its keep big and short.
gen-gf-goldman-outfit: Approachable Outfit gives the text cable-like curves of unchanging thickness. Over a long page that bent-wire stroke reads smooth and friendly under Goldman's wide, bold heading.
gen-gf-goldman-plus-jakarta-sans: Plus Jakarta Sans is a monoline sans with curve endings kept well apart, crossbars as thick as its stems. Next to Goldman's wide, commanding letters it feels precise and modern.
